title: Pathology ensemble: 3 of 4 flows never proven; heterogeneous-panel + in-band-error retry never exercised live
wanted_capability: Live proof coverage for the pathology ensemble family. (a) arch-pathology-java, perf-pathology-rust, perf-pathology-java are designed+shipped but never installed/team-instantiated/smoke-run — each needs brofiles+panel teamplates+facilitators+workflows installed, `bro_team create` for the panels, and one smoke run. (b) arch-pathology-rust was only proven end-to-end (PE-6) with the panel+validator repointed to codex during a bro-harness provider outage (~2026-06-01 08:00Z); re-run on the real heterogeneous brodex/deepseek/glm panel. (c) The bro-harness in-band SSE error surface+retry fix (anthropic.rs, commit cef654a) is unit-tested but the retry path was never exercised live — confirm on the next transient overload.
notes: Extracted from thread-cc07f395 items 1, 2, 4 during thread triage. Requires the prod daemon host + healthy harness providers; not portable filesystem work.
